appDesc.message: Download the current page's video with a local yt-dlp, via Ctrl+Alt+Click or the popup.

savePathHint.message:
Folder for yt-dlp to save into. Absolute paths are used as-is; relative paths go under the default Downloads folder.
{domain} = site domain, {title} = video title. Combine / nest allowed (e.g. {domain}/{title}).

usageNoShortcut.message: How to use: use the list or the on-video icon

useCookiesHint.message: Downloads using your logged-in Chrome session's cookies. Needed for member-only / purchased videos, but if the cookies can't be read the download may fail.

usage.message: How to use: {combo} + Click a video, or use the list / on-video icon

hostMissingHint.message: The native host does not seem installed. Run native/install.ps1.

noVideos.message: No videos found on this tab. Play it and refresh, or use 'This whole page' below.
